$comment: Weights for the final suitability score. Components are each normalised to 0..1 before weighting, then the weighted mean is taken over whichever components are present. Weights need not sum to 1 (they are renormalised), so you can zero one out without rebalancing the rest.

terrain_subweights.$comment: How elevation / slope / aspect combine into the single terrain component.

access_subweights.$comment: Drive and hike are scored separately here AND surfaced separately in the UI; this weighting only affects the ranking number.

legality.$comment: Legality is a flag, not a score component - it never silently sinks a site's rank. `exclude_from_ranking` classes are dropped from the ranked list entirely; `flag_only` classes stay ranked but are marked prominently in the UI.

hard_filters.$comment: Applied before scoring. A cell failing any of these is not a candidate at all.
